purpose: Derive the exact hard-hard -> homogeneous (spatial q=0, nonzero frequency) cubic sources for the global variables zeta_0 and n_0 from the same fixed candidate action. Reduce the finite-k hard scalar shift first, then couple the two hard modes to the independently certified homogeneous/global block of s6fK. Determine whether a genuine homogeneous virtual exchange exists or whether the global Hamiltonian constraint projects it out. This gate is outcome-neutral and precedes any rerun of the s6fF ZERO/NONZERO soft-s classification.

frozen_action.clock: fixed C8 shift-symmetric P(X_U) action from research/RTK_C8_U1_FIXED_SCALAR_ACTION_v1.json

required_derivation: expand the full fixed action to terms linear in one homogeneous field (zeta_0 or n_0) and quadratic in two finite-k hard scalar fields
include gravitational kinetic, R3, P(X_U), C(X_U)(DTheta_U)^2 and alpha6(X_U) D_iR3D^iR3 pieces from the same action
use the exact finite-k hard lapse/shift solution appropriate to the candidate branch before forming the hard-hard homogeneous source
do not use a punctured q->0 beta solution for the homogeneous leg
derive source vector S_hom=(S_zeta0,S_n0) for equal-|k| COM hard modes
invert only the s6fK homogeneous/global quadratic block, exposing Delta_N and any frequency-dependent homogeneous denominator
classify exactly whether the homogeneous virtual exchange is absent/projected, finite nonzero, or singular on an explicit denominator surface
keep bare n=2 and alpha6 state-function contact pieces separate from homogeneous exchange until the final sum

outcome_policy.projected: scientific PASS if the exact global constraint removes the homogeneous virtual channel
outcome_policy.finite: scientific PASS if a finite source and exchange are derived
outcome_policy.singular: scientific PASS_SCOPED if an explicit fixed-action degeneracy surface is derived; do not tune parameters away from it
outcome_policy.incomplete: BLOCKED if any same-action cubic source is not source-locked; missing terms may not be silently set to zero

forbidden: using any special mu direction or angular average from the punctured limit
fitting M_U, M_K, lambda_HL or alpha6 to force cancellation
dropping P(X_U) or C(X_U) cubic terms because their quadratic spatial gradients vanish on the homogeneous leg
claiming final soft-s cancellation before bare+alpha6+homogeneous pieces are explicitly summed
next_if_complete: Combine the archived bare n=2 cubic vertex, alpha6(X) state-function contribution, and the exact homogeneous/global exchange from s6fL, then rerun the unchanged s6fF ZERO/NONZERO semantics on the frozen candidate branch.
